numerical_policy: Centered output; selectively widened finite ill-conditioned float32 channels; channel-only inverse computed in float64 then cast once. Native CPU affine output differences explicitly retained, not hidden by relaxed general tolerances.
performance_scope: Joint BatchNorm versus Tensor composition in the same current library, not native Torch or an unsupported old-release BN API. 16 fresh sequential processes, two per implementation/dtype/runtime, balanced ABBA, all 9 batch samples retained. CPU float64 eval backward costs about4.3% more; it preserves native dynamic-running-buffer behavior.
historical_failures: Native audit first tried reading freed saved statistics; corrected collection before backward. Prototype tests initially attempted unsupported direct non-leaf writes, now exercise shared storage through supported detached aliases. No-grad running-statistic flags and forward-stat dual semantics were corrected against native observations. Raw original logs retained.
